briefing.geography: Two exposed relay ridges stand at height five above a thick valley floor, split by a dead gap and line-of-sight fog pockets.
goals: Link the four ridge relays by line of sight.
Record one patrol and hand it to a drone.
Keep the replay inside linked relay coverage.
rules: Relays connect only when they can see one another.
Recorded patrols stop when they enter a dead zone.
Four relay sites span the two exposed ridges.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.

Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.
